rules: PRODUCTION_SPEC §12–§18: centred, flat LIGHT backgrounds (no black), whole real products only, 1–3 words, flat 2-D objects next to the part they describe, labels by the part (spatial contiguity), visuals on the word (±2 f), no captions, watermark bottom-right below content (y 1240–1340 box), logo v5 end card. Audio LOCKED: audio/narrate.py af_heart 0.795 0.30 0.42 + mix.sh (pronunciations.json applies Xiaomi's/Mijia).
palette_for_this_video: paper #FAF8F5 main; warm sand #EFE3CC for Sand Gold scenes; lavender #ECE8FB for the night/beam beat (a light 'dusk' tint, NOT black); blush #FBE7E2 for THE CATCH; marigold #FFB224 object fills; ember #C2410C accent text; wreck #E5484D only for the catch stamp

scenes.image: A Sand Gold hero, standing upright, centred, 60–65% width
scenes.object: beam cone (marigold, 30% opacity) shoots up from the head; number rolls 0→1,000 above it (0.33 s roll, hold)
scenes.transition_in: frame 1 (hook): product + number already 70% visible so frame 1 reads instantly

scenes.object: price tag swings from the lanyard hole, settles with damping

scenes.image: G both colours side by side (Sand Gold front, black behind), centred
scenes.object: none (hero beat)

scenes.image: A hero alone; black one fades back
scenes.object: two colour dots (black, sand gold); sand gold dot pulses
calipers clamp the length; label '130 mm' sits ON the caliper bar

scenes.image: C side view sits on a minimal balance scale line
scenes.object: scale tips level; '125 g' next to the scale pan

scenes.image: E beam/lit photo or A hero lying horizontal on the left third
scenes.object: beam cone extends to the right across the frame with a distance ruler ticking 0→150 m along its edge; label at the far end
three beam cones of different widths/brightness appear one by one on each number

scenes.image: F lamp/ambient photo (or A hero with a soft round glow at the side light)
scenes.object: soft glow circle behind the product shifts colour 4000K → 3300K → 2700K (cool-white → warm); small swatches with the K values beside the glow
flame icon flickers on top; then SOS as three dot–dash pulses; then strobe flashes (gentle, no full-screen flashing)

scenes.image: D base with hook (close-up zoom on the real photo), then whole product
scenes.object: marigold callout ring on the hook; then a simple tent outline and the light hanging from its apex, swinging gently
battery cell beside the product fills segment by segment; label '3,100 mAh' on the battery
clock ring sweeps to 30 h next to the battery
wreck-red stamp THE CATCH drops (1.3→1.0, −4°), 3 px shake
beam cone shrinks from wide to a faint narrow beam; '50 lm' label at the beam; clock '30 h' stays
rain drops bounce off ✓ ; then a swimmer icon/wave with a strike-through on 'swimming'

scenes.image: B black original next to A Sand Gold
scenes.object: calendar flips to 2024 above the black one; '≠ new' then an arrow to the colour swatch on the Sand Gold one
logo v5 wordmark below; the k snaps upright (SPEC)
small 'own the black one?' check → skip arrow
beam + 1,000 as frame 1 (seamless loop)
